description.value:
Your body has a hardpoint, hidden away in an internal compartment within one of your arms, that can hold one weapon. You gain a tactical hideaway limb for free that doesn't count against your total implant limit, except it can only hold one weapon, and this weapon must be a one-handed weapon of light Bulk or less. When you Draw this weapon, the weapon drawn is integrated into your body and can't be disarmed, dropped, or stolen. These effects last until you stow the weapon in the hideaway compartment.

Special If you have the Thresher KO-1 Frame lineage feat, the weapon can instead be a one-handed weapon of 1 Bulk or less.
